data.name: Forestmatic
data.description: Forestmatic is a Belgian "reforestation as a service" startup that links brands and businesses with tree-planting projects run by partners around the world. It sells planting packages and provides digital tracking of each tree, plus drone-based survival monitoring. It does not plant or manage forests itself.
